summary: The focused object printing obligation is satisfied by the old harness on both source versions. Full batch coverage is not established by this focused assessment.

assessment.necessity_reason: The harness prints only a parser-returned tree. Parsing and printing start at depth zero and use the same nesting limit for arrays and objects, so the new object print check does not reject an object at a depth accepted by parsing.

before.requirement: Print a parser-produced object at a nesting depth accepted by parsing without rejecting its depth.
before.reason: The old object printer has no depth rejection.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Object parsing checks the shared nesting limit and increments depth.
Array parsing counts mixed container nesting against the same limit.
The parse buffer starts with zero depth before parsing the value.

after.requirement: Print a parser-produced object at a nesting depth accepted by parsing without rejecting its depth.
after.reason: The new object check uses the parser's nesting threshold. The print paths start at zero depth, and array and object printers increment depth for nested containers.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Object parsing checks the same nesting limit and increments depth.
Array parsing counts mixed container nesting against the same limit.
Array printing applies the same limit and increments print depth.
Unbuffered printing initializes the print buffer at zero depth before dispatch.
Buffered printing also initializes zero depth before dispatch.

assessment.comparison_reason: For the frozen g0002 obligation, both versions can print parser-produced objects at accepted nesting depths; the added check does not create a depth mismatch.
